text:
sara-partnerships: Starting a focused thread to get marketplace onboarding greenlit across AWS/GCP/Azure. Need to capture publisher account IDs, required roles, KMS flow for private offers, SKU pricing tiers, and any legal/regulatory flags. Short, actionable please.

rafael-cloud: I'll surface the publisher account IDs and service-account roles for GCP, plus AWS IAM roles. Preliminary list: aws-pub-12345, gcp-pub-redwood, azure-pub-rdinfer. Need confirmation from platform on least-privilege role.

emma-legal: Important: include data residency opt-out language for EU customers and a SOC2/pen-test statement for marketplace copy. Also, for Azure private offers we need a separate MSFT MSA clause. I'll draft the minimal text.

leo-sales: Pricing signal from field: customers prefer clear metering (e.g., "inference-hours" or "token-units"). Also want an SI partner add-on SKU for managed integration. Proposal: 3 SKUs - dev (low qps), standard (metered), enterprise (reserved + SI add-on). Trial: 10-seat, 7-day by default.

nina-custsuccess: For onboarding playbook, we need a test-customer account for each cloud with sample VPC/KMS configs so partners can validate Private Offer flows. I can coordinate two pilot customers.

rafael-cloud: Tech checklist (high-level):
- publisher account ids for each cloud
- service account / IAM role with MarketPlacePublish permissions
- KMS: allowEnrollPolicy + customer-key-usage cross-account policy
- manifest v2 with SKUs + pricing.json (see example snippet)

```yaml
offer: redwood-inference
skus:
  - id: rdi-dev
    name: Developer
    pricing_unit: inference-hour
    trial_days: 7
  - id: rdi-standard
    name: Standard
    pricing_unit: token-unit
    trial_days: 7
  - id: rdi-enterprise
    name: Enterprise
    pricing_unit: reserved-hours
    includes: [private-offer, sla-uptime]
regions: [us-west-2, us-east-1, europe-west1, europe-north1]
```

emma-legal: Thanks. Two legal asks: 1) confirm if any telemetry contains PII (we need to flag in the privacy clause), 2) confirm the exact SLA wording for "enterprise" SKU so legal can align.

rafael-cloud: Telemetry is aggregate by default; we send anonymized usage metrics. For enterprise tenants we may accept customer-provided KMS so logs do not leave customer VPC.

leo-sales: SLA: 99.9% request success and <200ms median infer latency for small models; enterprise can opt for dedicated capacity with custom SLOs. I'll formalize.

infra-bot: Reminder: marketplace-validator will reject manifests missing logo asset > 1024x1024 or missing support contact.

nina-custsuccess: Action owners: Rafael (publisher accounts & manifest) ; Emma (legal copy + residency/telemetry language) ; Leo (SKU pricing & SLA text) ; Sara (pilot customers + upload coordination). Can we target a validation upload by next Thu?

rafael-cloud: Target works. I'll push initial IAM docs and a terraform snippet for cross-account KMS in the shared drive.

emma-legal: I'll aim for draft clauses by Tue and ping for review.

leo-sales: I'll assemble expected price bands and SI add-on language by Wed EOD.

sara-partnerships: Perfect. Scheduling a 30min sync Fri 9am PT to walk the manifest and legal lines before upload. I'll drop calendar invite and link to the shared drive. :calendar: :rocket:

infra-bot: Note: after upload run tries automatic schema and asset checks; failures will be posted here with codes.

sara-partnerships: Thanks team - please drop any blockers here. If anyone from hardware partners (for on-prem inference appliance listings) wants to join the pilot convo, call them out and I'll loop them in.

leo-sales: I'll invite the SI/hardware partner leads after the first validation passes.

nina-custsuccess: Adding the two pilot customer IDs to the shared doc now.
